test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six classmates, Kanti, Manoj, Suman, Divya, Anuj and Mohit, are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). All classmates are sitting at the sides of the table, nobody is sitting at the corners. Kanti is sitting on a side alone. Manoj and Suman are sitting on the same side of the table. Mohit is sitting alone on the opposite side of Kanti. Divya is sitting to the immediate left of Mohit. Anuj and Divya are sitting on the same side of the table. Suman is sitting second to the right of Divya.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of Kanti?
solution:
Given: Six classmates, Kanti, Manoj, Suman, Divya, Anuj and Mohit, are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. All classmates are sitting at the sides of the table, nobody is sitting at the corners.

1) Kanti is sitting on a side alone.

2) Mohit is sitting alone on the opposite side of Kanti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c42567099f1caebe7cb7618d7e48f3c2583e87c6c840e12706a632b85cbe983.png] 

3) Divya is sitting to the immediate left of Mohit.

4) Anuj and Divya are sitting on the same side of the table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e68ce4bbc43c751f26f16dadc77fb93d8a769839c6ea788bc4469bdd6f14b0a.png] 

5) Suman is sitting second to the right of Divya.

6) Manoj and Suman are sitting on the same side of the table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6a67566e7525f1a2e56c706c492d250a408288da297bc4fbc67b07f0285b9df.png] 

So, **Anuj **is sitting to the immediate right of Kant.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Anuj".**
